title: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. translated_title: 时序逻辑张量网络：神经网络中时序推理的基础
translated_abstract: 在动态场景中——足球比赛、交通流、手术或装配过程——动作以根本不同的时间尺度展开：在足球中，一次踢球发生在毫秒级，一次控球持续数秒，而诸如成功传球后进球这类复杂事件则在较长时间跨度上组合了多个原子动作。仅基于视觉数据训练的模型难以在不同时间尺度上有效学习，缺乏在细粒度瞬间与更宽泛区间之间进行推理的原则性方法。逐点语义与纯区间语义均不充分：前者将事件碎片化为缺乏整体事件识别的帧级快照；后者将区间视为原子真值，忽略了状态轨迹。我们提出了时序逻辑张量网络，这是一个可微分的神经符号框架，通过一种形式化的多类逻辑来解决这一二元性问题，其中事件与状态在结构上相互依赖……
tldr: 本文提出时序逻辑张量网络，这是一个可微分的神经符号框架，通过形式化的多类逻辑使事件与状态在结构上相互依赖，为神经网络在多个时间尺度上的时序推理奠定基础。
en_tdlr: We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework that establishes the foundations of temporal reasoning in neural networks through a formal multi-sorted logic in which events and states are structurally interdependent across multiple time scales.
